name: Granola Style 2.0
description: Outcome-first meeting notes: summary, topic-grouped discussion points, explicit decisions, verb-first action items, open questions, and next steps. Sections are omitted entirely when the meeting had nothing for them.

sections.title: Summary
sections.instruction: Write a 2-4 sentence overview of the meeting's purpose and most important outcomes. Lead with outcomes, not the agenda. Omit this section entirely if the meeting was too short to summarize meaningfully.

sections.title: Key Discussion Points
sections.instruction: One bullet per distinct topic, formatted as '- **<Topic>**: <what was discussed, in the terms participants used>'. Group by topic, not chronology. Preserve the participants' original wording for scope and ownership - do not reword for fluency. Omit topics that were only briefly touched on unless they carry decisions or actions.

sections.title: Decisions
sections.instruction: One bullet per decision, formatted as '- <decision> — <who decided / how it was resolved>', including the who/how part only if explicitly stated in the transcript. Only include items explicitly agreed or resolved: a topic being discussed is not a decision. Omit this section entirely if no decisions were made.

sections.title: Action Items
sections.instruction: One checkbox bullet per task, formatted as '- [ ] <action> — <owner> (due: <date>)', where the owner appears only if explicitly named and the due date only if explicitly stated. Never infer owners or deadlines from attendance or context. Phrase each action verb-first as a concrete task. Omit this section entirely if no action items exist.

sections.title: Open Questions / Follow-ups
sections.instruction: One bullet per unresolved question or item explicitly deferred to a future meeting. Include only items explicitly left open in the transcript. Omit this section entirely if there are none.

sections.title: Next Steps / Next Meeting
sections.instruction: State the scheduled follow-up or agreed next checkpoint, if one was mentioned. Omit this section entirely if it was not discussed.
